name: Air China Limited
summary: Air China Limited is a Beijing-headquartered airline group, founded in 1988 and a subsidiary of China National Aviation Holding Corporation Limited. It carries passengers and cargo on routes spanning mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Europe, North America, Japan, Korea and wider Asia Pacific, and organizes its business into airline operations and other operations. It also supplies aircraft engineering and overhaul, ground handling, cabin and catering services, ticketing, human resources and financial services, and engages in import and export trade.
